records.name: Switzerland

adds.title: Gesetz über den Justizvollzug (Justizvollzugsgesetz, JVG) vom 13. November 2019 — Basel-Stadt detention law (TGNS)
adds.summary: Primary legal text of the canton of Basel-Stadt's detention law (JVG, adopted 13 Nov 2019 by the Grand Council). §2 Trennungsvorschriften requires separation of female and male detainees and stipulates that 'the gender identity of the detained person is respected as far as possible' (Die Geschlechtsidentität der eingewiesenen Person wird soweit möglich beachtet); the prison directorate may deviate from the separation rules in consultation with the referring authority. This is the explicit 2019 inclusion of gender identity in a Swiss detention law aimed at protecting transgender people's placement in correctional facilities.

adds.title: LGBTQ rights in Switzerland — placement of transgender people in correctional facilities (Wikipedia)
adds.summary: Wikipedia overview of Swiss LGBTQ rights records that in November 2019 the Grand Council of Basel-Stadt voted to include 'gender identity' in its law on detention to better protect transgender people in regard to placement in correctional facilities, citing the TGNS-documented JVG. No national (federal) trans-prisoner placement rule is documented in the article — placement practice is cantonal; no Swiss case law, special trans units or federal solitary-confinement practice for trans prisoners are noted.

records.note: Switzerland: no federal trans-prisoner placement rule identified; the only documented placement protection is Basel-Stadt's 13 Nov 2019 detention law requiring gender identity to be respected 'as far as possible' in male/female separation. Thin-but-usable: single canton, single instrument, no documented cases.

records.name: Greece

adds.title: Φυλακές Κορυδαλλού: Τρανς κρατούμενες θα μεταχθούν για πρώτη φορά στη γυναικεία πτέρυγα (LiFO)
adds.summary: LiFO (4 Dec 2021): four trans detainees were ordered transferred to the women's prisons of Korydallou (Athens) by decision of the General Secretary for Crime-Prevention Policy Sofia Nikolaou, after each had petitioned for transfer stating they identify and wish to be treated as women. The four (three Greek, one Bulgarian) had been held at Trikala and Corfu prisons, effectively isolated and treated inconsistently with their self-identified gender. First documented transfer of trans prisoners to a women's facility in Greece; it illustrates that default placement had followed the male facilities and that an on-request transfer route to women's facilities existed.

adds.title: LGBTQ rights in Greece — Correctional Facilities section (Wikipedia)
adds.summary: Wikipedia's overview of Greek LGBTQ rights records under 'Correctional Facilities' that since 4 December 2021 trans women detainees, upon their request, may be relocated to correctional facilities for women — the policy change matching the Korydallou transfers reported by LiFO the same day. Placement thus starts from the registered sex, with a 4 Dec 2021 decision creating an on-request transfer route for trans women; the article documents no special trans units and no rule covering trans men's placement.

records.note: Greece: on-request relocation of trans women detainees to women's facilities established 4 Dec 2021, first exercised at Korydallou; no data found on trans men's placement or trans-specific units.
